data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. Valuation is triangulated against a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health, including same-stage private comparables Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B), alongside public references RXRX, TEM, and ONT.L.

Two methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $180M total raised proxy, implying $306M. Peer-median analysis draws from three same-sector, same-stage private companies, yielding a median valuation of $3.8B (range: $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-comp anchoring using sector P/S multiples (8.1x median across Biotech & Health) cannot be applied, as the target's revenue is not on file.

Triangulation across the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $260M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The substantial spread reflects the wide dispersion in peer Series C valuations, driven by variance in clinical stage, de-risking, and market composition within the sector. Key uncertainties include target revenue, pipeline advancement, and clinical data maturity relative to peer set.
